title: Coherent ambient lighting tokens
summary: Define one light direction and intensity model so raised, inset and flat surfaces share consistent highlights and shadows across a tactile interface.
when_to_use: A hardware-like control panel needs depth without independently hand-tuning every component.
avoid_when: The product needs flat, high-density operational UI where decorative depth would obscure hierarchy.

anatomy.purpose: Owns shared direction, hue and key/fill intensity values.
Maps material color and elevation to a predictable light response.
Uses a consistent chamfer or inset rule across controls.
Changes elevation or shading on hover, press and disabled states without moving the light source.

tokens.name: --amb-key-light-intensity
tokens.purpose: Strength of primary highlights and shadows.

tokens.name: --amb-elevation
tokens.purpose: Depth used by surface and edge rules.

states.name: pressed
states.behavior: Reduce apparent elevation and strengthen inset cues.

states.name: disabled
states.behavior: Lower contrast while preserving readable labels.

responsive: Use the same light direction at every breakpoint; scale depth and shadow spread to the component size.
accessibility: Never rely on shading alone to convey a control state.
Check text contrast on the lightest and darkest generated surfaces.
implementation_steps: Define the shared lighting tokens in the user's existing theme layer.
Map surface roles and elevation levels to those tokens.
Implement controls using the project's own components and verify state contrast.
